meta.name: paid-ads-x
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, and safely operate connected X Ads (Twitter Ads) accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for X Ads performance, campaign or line-item analysis, spend, conversions, targeting, promoted posts, audiences, budgets, bids, creative, campaign setup, or approved X Ads changes.

copy.tagline: 诊断并优化 X 广告投放效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要管理或优化 X 平台上的广告活动
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and optimize X ads performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage or optimize ads on X

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 NotFair 连接器查看和分析 X Ads(推特广告)账户数据(如花费、转化、预算等),并在你批准后安全地修改广告系列。它先确认账户信息,再给出基于数据的诊断和下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你说要分析或操作 X Ads(推特广告)账户时触发,例如查看广告系列/广告组表现、花费、转化等。

say.text: 分析一下 X Ads 上个月的花费和转化。
say.note: Claude 会读取账户数据并给出诊断。

say.text: 把广告系列“夏季促销”的日预算从 100 改成 150 美元。
say.note: Claude 会展示变更详情,等你批准后执行。

say.text: 看看定向“美国 18-34 岁”的广告组表现。
say.note: Claude 会按定向筛选并汇总表现。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can view and analyze X Ads (Twitter Ads) account data (spend, conversions, budgets, bids, etc.) via NotFair, and modify campaigns after your approval. It confirms account details, then gives data-based diagnosis and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze or operate an X Ads (Twitter Ads) account, e.g., reviewing campaign/line-item performance, spend, conversions, etc.

say_en.text: Analyze last month's spend and conversions on X Ads.
say_en.note: It reads account data and gives a diagnosis.

say_en.text: Change daily budget of campaign 'Summer Sale' from $100 to $150.
say_en.note: It shows details and waits for your approval.

say_en.text: Show ad groups targeting US, ages 18-34.
say_en.note: It filters and summarizes performance by targeting.
